BLASK Engineering is a reputable manufacturing company specializing in structural steel. We are currently seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Metal Fabricator/Boilermaker to join our rapidly expanding and fast paced workforce. In this position, you will play a crucial role in the production process, contributing to the fabrication of high-quality metal products.
Annual Salary - $79,500 to $80,000 + superannuation 
Full Time 
Responsibilities:
•	Interpret technical drawings, and specifications to determine fabrication requirements.
•	Operate a variety of machinery and tools such as shears, press brakes, saws, grinders, and welding equipment to cut, shape, and assemble metal components.
•	Perform accurate measurements and layout work to ensure precision and conformity to specifications.
•	Select appropriate materials and metals for each project based on project requirements and specifications.
•	Have a considerable amount of knowledge in MIG welding. Knowledge in TIG and Stick desirable.
•	Conduct quality checks to verify the accuracy, completeness, and dimensional requirements of fabricated metal parts.
•	Troubleshoot and resolve issues that may arise during the fabrication process, such as equipment malfunctions or material defects.
•	Maintain a clean and organized work area, ensuring compliance with safety regulations and company policies.
•	Collaborate with colleagues, including engineers and designers, to provide input on design improvements and optimize fabrication processes.
•	Keep up-to-date with industry trends, technological advancements, and best practices in metal fabrication.

Qualifications:
•	Certificate III or equivalent qualification 
•	Minimum of 1 year work experience is essential 
•	Proven experience as a Metal Fabricator or similar role, with a solid understanding of metalworking principles and techniques.
•	Proficiency in reading and interpreting technical drawings, and specifications.
•	Demonstrated proficiency in operating fabrication machinery and tools, including shears, press brakes, saws, grinders, and welding equipment.
•	Experience with various welding techniques.
•	Excellent mathematical skills, including the ability to perform precise measurements and calculations.
•	Detail-oriented approach with a commitment to producing accurate and high-quality work.
•	Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot and resolve fabrication issues effectively.
•	Knowledge of safety protocols and procedures related to metal fabrication.
•	Effective communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.

If you believe you meet the above qualifications and are ready to take on this exciting opportunity, we invite you to apply for the Metal Fabricator position at BLASK Engineering. We look forward to reviewing your application.

Please forward CV and resume through to samantha@blask.com.au

Biànca was born out of a desire to bring the spirit of Italian dining to Brisbane's Fortitude Valley, capturing the effervescence of a classic trattoria within a sleek, warm, and colourful setting. Earn up to $1,000 when you refer a friend who joins our team

Vacancy Listing Dates 21/07/2026 to 18/08/2026
- Experienced Professionals wanted!
- Remuneration from $90,000 to $190,000
- Join the team at MLG Oz

MLG Oz is a West Australian owned and operated business with operations located throughout WA and NT.

We are currently looking for Welders / Boilermakers, Motor Mechanics, Diesel Motor Mechanics, Fitters, Metal Fabricators, Industrial Electricians & Auto Electricians across all of our sites.

To be successful in your application, you will need the following:
- Relevant trade qualifications required to perform your duties
- Minimum 3 years' exp. with a demonstrated safety and performance record
- Sound knowledge of workshop and remote site operations
- Experience reading, interpreting, following and communicating information on written job instructions, specifications, standard operating procedures, charts, lists, drawings and other applicable reference documents
- Demonstrated ability to work in multi-disciplinary work teams

You will be required to:
- Undertake repairs and servicing to MLG Oz plant and equipment as indicated by the site supervisor
- Maintain applicable service and operation records
- Order material and parts required for repairs and servicing of oxy and welding plant and equipment in consultation with the Leading Hand and Purchasing Officer/Store person
- Test run site plant and equipment following repairs
- Liaise with the Leading Hand and Site Supervisor on plant and equipment repairs
- Ensure your work environment is maintained through daily housekeeping and equipment inspections
- Take reasonable care to ensure your personal safety and health and that of other personnel whilst in the workplace
- Undertake any other works as directed by the Workshop Supervisor, within your skills and abilities
- Comply with policies, procedures and all safety requirements of MLG Oz and their client whilst on site
- Facilitate the achievement of MLG Oz's goals and objectives relevant to the Kalgoorlie Workshop

We are also currently seeking an experienced Mining Engineer to join our team in Goldfields.

In this role you will be responsible for the development of plans and techniques to meet our mining operations clients' needs. The role will manage assigned projects from start-to-finish, including design and documentation of equipment specifications. In addition, the Engineer will complete all tasks assigned by the Project Manager and/or Civil Manager, assisting with project specific reviews, conducting research, and writing reports. The intent of the role is to support operations in striving towards standardisation of tasks, removal of waste processes, increasing productivity and reduction of costs.

You will be expected to ensure that projects are completed on-time, within the allocated budget, and are resourced accordingly. There will be travel to client facilities to oversee implementation and ongoing reporting and compliance.

Tasks include, but are not limited to:
- Always observe company health and safety requirements and regulations
- Establish professional relationships with staff
- Maintain a high degree of professionalism and diligence
- Prepare plans with detailed drawings that include project specifications and cost estimates
- Design and execute engineering experiments to create workable solutions
- Develop engineering calculations, diagrams and technical reports
- Complete required technical and regulatory documents
- Ensure projects are completed on time and within the specified budget
- Present analysis results and project solutions to technical leads, senior leaders and clients as necessary
- Identify areas where improvements and savings could be made, or efficiencies generated
- Travel to sites operations as required

To be considered for this role, the successful applicant will possess:
- 3+ years' related work exp.
- Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, design or electrical engineering
- Drivers Licence
- Initiative in problem solving within assigned tasks
- Able to perform effectively within a team environment
- Demonstrated proficiency in written and verbal communication, including creating and delivering presentations
- Advanced skills in critical software applications
- Expertise in data and problem analysis, creative problem solving and design thinking

Additionally, we are seeking a Civil Engineer to join our team. Applicants must have at least 3 years' related work exp. and hold a Bachelor's degree in mechanical, industrial, design or electrical engineering.

The Civil Engineer will be responsible for the development of plans and techniques to meet our mining operations clients' needs. The role will manage assigned projects from start-to-finish, including design and documentation of equipment specifications. In addition, the Engineer will complete all tasks assigned by the Project Manager and/or Civil Manager, assisting with project specific reviews, conducting research, and writing reports. The intent of the role is to support operations in striving towards standardisation of tasks, removal of waste processes, increasing productivity and reduction of costs.

Remuneration packages from $90,000 - $190,000 will be offered to the successful candidates.

We are also seeking an experienced Occupational Health and Safety Inspector / HSE Advisor to join our site based Crushing and Screening operations.

To be successful in your application, you will need the following:
- Certificate IV OHS
- Section 44 Appointed Person
- Ability to pass a Pre-employment medical, incl. Drug & Alcohol screen
- 3+ years' experience in system and documentation development
- Excellent working knowledge of Microsoft Office packages, particularly Word and Excel
- A high attention to detail to ensure high quality work outcomes.

The following will also be highly regarded:
- Diploma of Occupational/Workplace Health and Safety
- 3+ years relevant mine site experience/crushing plants
- Previous machine operator experience.
- Cert IV Training and Assessment.

A remuneration package between $90,000 - $130,000 will be offered to the successful candidate

We are also seeking Drainers to join our team. You will play a key role in the installation, maintenance, and repair of drainage systems on civil and mining projects. This position involves working in remote environments as part of a skilled wider-earthworks crew, ensuring all drainage infrastructure is constructed to specification, safely, and efficiently. You will be expected to have strong experience in trenching, pipe laying, Tailings Storage Facilities and reading construction plans, along with a solid understanding of site safety standards and environmental considerations. You will be expected to operate machines at times on drainage jobs but also when drainage works are intermittent on the rest of the project.

The role requires adaptability to demanding site conditions and a commitment to high-quality workmanship while maintaining productivity targets. A proactive attitude, strong teamwork skills, and the ability to work long shifts in remote FIFO conditions are essential for success in this role.

You will also need to demonstrate a minimum of 3 years work exp.

Responsibilities:
- Install underground drainage systems, including stormwater, subsoil drainage, and TSF infrastructure
- Read and interpret engineering drawings and site plans
- Ideally be able to set out pipe alignments and levels using lasers and surveying equipment
- Excavate trenches and prepare bedding materials
- Lay pipes, align joints, and ensure correct gradients
- Backfill and compact trenches to specification
- Conduct inspections and testing of installed systems
- Operate and work around heavy machinery safely - during drainage works and during other TSF project works.
- Maintain tools, equipment, and a clean work environment

A remuneration package between $90,000 - $110,000 will be offered .

New Project Support Officer Role | Full-Time Assignment - Kelvin Grove   
  Your new company     Our client is a well-regarded organisation within the education sector, supporting a large and diverse environment. Due to an internal backfill opportunity within the Facilities Management team, an experienced Project Support Officer is required to provide operational and administrative support across business operations and facilities-related functions. This position is based at Kelvin Grove.    Your new role   
 Reporting to the Business Operations Manager, you will play a key role supporting the day-to-day administration of the Facilities Management team. This is a varied position that will see you coordinating administrative, purchasing and facilities-related activities while ensuring business operations run smoothly. 
   
 Key responsibilities include: 
 
 Processing invoices and supporting financial administration 
 Coordinating purchasing activities and raising orders 
 Managing stationery, uniforms and general office resources 
 Assisting with audits, record keeping and compliance activities 
 Supporting facilities' management administrative functions 
 Maintaining accurate documentation and databases 
 Assisting with project coordination and business support activities 
 Liaising with internal stakeholders to support operational outcomes 
 Providing general administrative support across the broader team 
 
   What you'll need to succeed   
 To be successful in this role, you will demonstrate: 
 
 Previous experience in administration, project support, business support or facilities administration 
 Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities 
 Experience processing invoices, purchase orders or financial transactions 
 Excellent attention to detail and record management skills 
 Strong communication and stakeholder engagement abilities 
 Proficiency across Microsoft Office applications, particularly Outlook, Word and Excel 
 The ability to quickly learn internal systems and processes 
 Experience in facilities management, property, construction, maintenance or similar environments will be highly regarded. 
 
 Formal qualifications are not essential. Relevant experience and the ability to hit the ground running are key. 
   What you'll get in return   
 
 Full-time contract opportunity 
 Convenient Kelvin Grove location 
 Paid on-site parking 
 Flexible working hours between 8:00am and 6:00pm 
 Exposure to a large and professional facilities' management environment 
 Supportive and collaborative team culture 
 Assignment starting from 27/07/2026 until 27/11/2026 with no extension at this stage. 
 
 Please note that working from home arrangements are not expected initially, with potential flexibility to be reviewed following commencement. Due to the nature of the vacancy, this position is not anticipated to extend beyond the contracted period.

Our Company

TerraCom Limited (ASX: TER) is an Australian based mining resources company with a global footprint, comprising a large portfolio of operating assets in Australia and South Africa within the coal sectors. We are a renowned low-cost producer focused on delivering exceptional outcomes from our high yielding diversified asset portfolio for its investors. TerraCom owns and operates the Blair Athol Coal Mine, in Central Queensland. This open-cut thermal coal operation consists of a full suite of mining activities inclusive of dragline, truck and excavator, dozer push, mine site rehabilitation, coal processing, coal crushing, product haulage and train load-out activities.

The Blair Athol Coal mine is located 24km northwest of the family-friendly township of Clermont in Central Queensland, 120 km northwest of Emerald and 275km southwest of Mackay.

TerraCom supports our people to grow, learn and develop their skills to reach their potential. We offer an exciting working environment, with career progression opportunities, as we truly believe that the capability and performance of our people is key to our success. Blair Athol Mine believes in fostering and nurturing each of our team members by providing them with a safe and enjoyable place to work, along with guidance and support from a leader they can rely upon. Come and play a key role in shaping our future!

The Role

We are currently seeking a highly motivated Surveyor Assistant / Technician to join our team at Blair Athol. You will assist the Surveyor in providing support for survey control to facilitate execution of mine activities including topsoil, stripping, overburden removal, coal mining, drilling/blasting, rehabilitation and associated projects around the mine. The right candidate will also forge a pathway towards further qualifications within the mine engineering team.

Responsibilities of the Role will include:

* Provide survey services and set out control points to ensure the accurate location and layout of work within the limits, offsets, grades, profiles and elevations for all mining related processes in accordance with the mine design criteria
* Conduct survey operations with drones, laser scanners and GPS and process the data to meet the required schedules
* Process survey data accurately and complete volume quantities
* Measure distances, angles and variations across site as directed
* Identify & escalate any non-conformance or processes that require corrective action.

Skills and Experience:

* A good work ethic, great communication skills and a desire to learn and grow
* A strong commitment to safety
* Survey or operational experience within a civil or mining environment
* Ability to prioritise and schedule work
* Ability to accurately measure and interpret data
* Competent user of MS Office tools

Benefits

* A fantastic opportunity to expand your mining career and join a great team offering exposure to all areas of operations and become part of the community in which you work.
* An attractive remuneration package in line with experience.
* An inclusive and supportive team culture.
* Excellent opportunity for career development

Note we thank all applicants for their interest, however any communications will be with short listed candidates only. No agency applications accepted.

SPYDER MOTORS PTY LTD is looking for an experienced Motor Mechanic for our automotive parts, vehicle servicing, and repair operations across NSW, WA in Australia. On a full-time basis, you will be part of a multidisciplinary and well-supported team.

Title: Motor Mechanic, Full-time position
Salary: A$ 90,000.00 to 98,000.00 plus super
Work Location: In person.

We are looking for applicants who demonstrate the following:
Requirements

• Minimum 3 years of relevant experience
• Certificate III in Light Vehicle Mechanical Technology or equivalent
• Strong knowledge of vehicle mechanical systems, engines, transmissions, steering, suspension, and braking systems
• Valid driver’s licence and own transport (preferred)
• Ability to use automotive diagnostic equipment and workshop tools
• Ability to read and interpret technical manuals, manufacturer specifications, and mechanical diagrams
• Physical stamina and strength
• Attention to detail and precision
• Good communication and teamwork skills
• Excellent diagnostic and problem-solving abilities

Responsibilities
• Inspect, test, and diagnose mechanical and electrical faults in motor vehicles using diagnostic equipment and testing tools.
• Diagnose faults in engines, transmissions, steering systems, suspension systems, braking systems, and other mechanical components.
• Dismantle and remove engine assemblies, transmissions, steering mechanisms, suspension components, and other vehicle parts.
• Repair or replace worn, damaged, or defective mechanical components in accordance with manufacturer specifications.
• Reassemble engines, transmissions, and other mechanical components following repairs.
• Perform scheduled maintenance and general vehicle servicing, including oil changes, filter replacement, lubrication, and engine tune-ups.
• Inspect, repair, and maintain vehicle braking, steering, suspension, cooling, fuel, and exhaust systems.
• Test and adjust repaired components to ensure correct operation, safety, and performance.
• Conduct road tests and post-repair inspections to confirm that identified faults have been rectified.
• Use hand tools, power tools, vehicle hoists, diagnostic scanners, and workshop equipment safely and efficiently.
• Maintain accurate records of vehicle inspections, diagnostic findings, repairs completed, parts used, and services performed.
• Estimate the parts, materials, labour, and time required to complete vehicle repairs and maintenance.
• Communicate with supervisors, customers, parts suppliers, and other team members regarding required repairs and vehicle conditions.
• Supervise and coordinate with apprentices, junior mechanics, and other workshop employees when required.
• Ensure all work complies with workplace health and safety requirements, environmental procedures, manufacturer specifications, and quality standards.
• Maintain a clean, organised, and safe workshop environment during and after the completion of work.
• Troubleshoot and resolve workshop and vehicle repair issues efficiently to ensure work is completed within required timeframes.

If you would like to discuss the role further, please click APPLY and send through an up-to-date CV. We can schedule in a time to discuss the positions available and what will be best suited to you.
